summary: Flappy Bird entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Flappy Bird

emulation.notes: Use real preserved mobile hardware/account if possible. Avoid APK sourcing assumptions without explicit provenance.

primary.platform: Original iOS / Android install if preserved
primary.why: The original Flappy Bird was removed from the App Store and Google Play in 2014, so the only faithful route is an already-preserved original install or device. Later revivals/clones should not be treated as the same archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a preserved device/account install of the original app. If unavailable, mark capture as unavailable rather than substituting a clone or later unrelated revival.

all_releases.fidelity: Original mobile release if still preserved on device/account.
all_releases.reason: primary: content authority, but delisted from normal current access.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Android release if preserved before delisting.
all_releases.reason: primary: same original game route, but no normal current storefront access.

all_releases.platform: Flappy Birds Family / arcade / later revivals
all_releases.reason: skip: not the original 2013 mobile game route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The complete original route depends on preservation, not current storefront availability.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not substitute clones or later revivals unless a separate entry documents them. The original creator's version is delisted.
